ios.desc:
GrogLog is a drink diary for people who want to drink less. It keeps an honest count and puts it where you can see it.

LOG IN ONE TAP
Your usual drinks sit on one screen, and a tap logs one. Long-press for another size, a drink you had earlier, or several at once. Over eleven hundred drinks are in the catalogue at their label strengths, from cask ale and craft beer to wine, spirits and Polish vodka, so a new one is a search away.

SEE WHERE THE DAY STANDS
Today is a running total against yesterday and your usual day, with what it has cost and how much of today's budget is left. A drink after midnight counts towards the evening it belonged to.

CUT DOWN AT A PACE YOU SET
Set a gradual reduction and GrogLog gives you a daily and weekly budget that comes down over time, within the limits in UK clinical guidance for reducing without medication.

AN HONEST RECORD
A forgotten day stays a gap rather than counting as a dry one, so your averages and streaks describe what happened. Reports chart each week and month against the ones before.

YOUR BODY, THE MORNING AFTER
If you allow it, GrogLog reads your heart rate, HRV and sleep from Apple Health and shows them against what you drank the evening before. It can also copy your drinks into Health.

PRIVATE AND FREE
There is no account, no server, no analytics and no advertising. Your log is stored on your phone and synced through your own iCloud account, so it comes back on a new iPhone; nobody else can read it. You can export all of it whenever you want. GrogLog is free, with nothing held back for a paid tier.

GrogLog does not provide medical advice. It is intended to help you follow a plan agreed with your GP or an alcohol service. If you are dependent on alcohol, stopping suddenly can be dangerous: please speak to a doctor before you begin.

quotes.text:
It’s designed for people who are alcohol dependent and want to get visibility and control over their drinking in order to cut down or stop. Fully offline, better features than many paid apps, and free/opensource as i don’t believe in profiting from misery https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/groglog-drink-tracker/id6817137190

it has stuff like burndown charts and tapering features to help people manage their reduction in medically safe ways which i felt was missing from the existing options

https://groglog.io

Some cool stuff

- daily/weekly/monthly reporting and charts so you can see how you’re doing relative to previous days/weeks

- lock screen widget so you can log a drink in two taps
- super easy ux so you can log just like “beer” or a specific brand/size depending on how accurate you want to be

- HealthKit integration so you can see how drinking is affecting your resting heart rate and HRV

- three different tapering modes so you can have a budget and reduce safely

- iCloud sync for if you switch phones

- it’s pretty and extremely lightweight

It’s a bit UK centric with regards to brands but there’s no reason it couldn’t be used in other places

The main inspiration was Drink Coach as it’s delightfully simple, but lacked certain things like being able to visualise your cadence or set a dynamic budget etc
